name: Syncthing Tray
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow Tier A behavior: Syncthing Tray installs an updater verifier that rejects an empty signature and verifies update bytes using compile-time selected public signing keys before applying the update.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact signing or deployment state beyond the checked-in key/configuration.
The final verifier implementation is delegated to Sparkle, tauri-plugin-updater, or self_update where applicable.
